name: Star Wars Genesis
summary: Star Wars Genesis is a free, fan-made total conversion project for Starfield, developed and continuously expanded by me, DeityVengy. It is fully playable via the Wabbajack auto-installer and receives regular updates and expansions. While technically a modlist, calling it that feels like an understatement. This is not your typical modlist that combines every mod out there into a jumbled mess and calls it a day. Countless mods and features within this modlist such as Coruscant, the Yuuzhan Vong Main Story, HUD, props, music, etc are made by me to work alongside other Star Wars mods made by other authors. Many of its features, such as new enemy factions, bosses, unique locations, and original quest content, are exclusive to Genesis and cannot be found anywhere else.
